title: MONTOYA_Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on radiation exposure of the German population by emergency imaging
summary: Data analysis to demonstrate the decline in emergency imaging is shown here. The evaluation of the comparison of radiation exposure in relation to age is checked using existing data. All data have been anonymized.

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of data on radiation exposure due to suspected diagnoses in connection with Long Covid, no risks for patients when evaluating existing data.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Computed Tomography in Emergency Imaging Emergency Department 
suspected diagnoses of pulmonary artery embolism, stroke, and cerebral haemorrhage                                                            
adults
Exclusion criteria:
Polytrauma                                                                                                             Patients minor to 18 years
